# dsh-dep-audit

Dependency supply-chain hygiene audit for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) projects and
profiles: peer-range resolvability, broken dist-tag detection, stale /
missing-license / non-registry dependencies, and installed-vs-declared drift.

- Install into dsh: `dsh plugin add dsh-dep-audit`
- CLI: `npx dsh-dep-audit . --json`
- Agent tool: `dep_audit(dir, options?)`
- Report envelope: `dsh-dep-audit/v1` — `{ schema, target, offline, ok, summary, checks }`
- Zero runtime dependencies (Node 18+ global fetch).
- Complements dsh-poison-guard (malware scan) and dsh-plugin-doctor (publish readiness).
